shortDescription: Resource module for Compliance Policys Rules Variables

options.name: dataType
options.description: The data type of the variable. IP mask is supported in IP address form (e.g., 255.255.255.0) only. Interface names must be provided in their full form, such as GigabitEthernet1/0/1.

options.name: defaultValue
options.description: The default value for the variable. This is applicable when `inputType` is `SINGLE_TEXT` or `MULTI_TEXT`. Ensure that any type of data is formatted as a string, but it must match the required format for the data type and adhere to any provided constraints.

options.name: description
options.description: A brief description of the variable.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. The `id` of the variable.

options.name: identifier
options.description: This is the identifier of the variable. Variables are referenced using the identifier enclosed in angle brackets. Update operation cannot be used to change the identifier.

options.name: inputType
options.description: The input type of the variable. For detailed enum descriptions, refer to the `Features` tab.

options.name: mandatory
options.description: Indicates if the variable is mandatory.

options.name: maxLength
options.description: The maximum length constraint for the `STRING` values. This is only applicable when the `inputType` is `SINGLE_TEXT` or `MULTI_TEXT`. Max length must be between 1 and 255, both inclusive.

options.name: maxValue
options.description: The maximum value constraint for the `INTEGER` variable. This is only applicable when the `inputType` is `SINGLE_TEXT` or `MULTI_TEXT`.

options.name: minValue
options.description: The minimum value constraint for the `INTEGER` variable. This is only applicable when the `inputType` is `SINGLE_TEXT` or `MULTI_TEXT`.

options.name: name
options.description: This is the name of the variable. It should be a concise and descriptive title that clearly identifies the variable. The name must be unique within the specified rule. Pattern ^\w\ \-\(\)+$.

options.name: policyId
options.description: PolicyId path parameter. The `id` of the compliance policy.

options.name: ruleId
options.description: RuleId path parameter. The `id` of the rule within the compliance policy.

options.name: selectionList
options.description: Compliance Policys Rules Variables's selectionList.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: validationRegex
options.description: A regular expression pattern for constraining `STRING` values. This is only applicable when the `inputType` is `SINGLE_TEXT` or `MULTI_TEXT`.
